prompt: I'm launching TaskFlow, a project management tool for small agencies (5–30 people). Can you build me a pricing page? Three plans: Starter (free, up to 3 projects), Studio ($12/user/mo) and Agency ($24/user/mo, adds client portals and time tracking). Annual billing gets 2 months free. Include an FAQ. Just a single pricing.html file, no build step.
assertions: pricing.html shows three plans with prices $0, $12 and $24 per user per month
pricing.html has a working monthly/annual toggle that changes the displayed Studio and Agency prices to reflect 2 months free
pricing.html includes an FAQ section with at least 4 questions
pricing.html uses no emoji characters in its visible text or icons
pricing.html has no purple/indigo-to-blue/pink gradient background behind the hero
pricing.html defines visible :focus-visible styles for interactive elements
pricing.html has no horizontal page scroll at a 390px-wide viewport
